candidate_tool: Frozen initial-8k word policy and global joint templates, at most 20 candidate IDs. No tool or memory update during this parameter study.
feedback_sampling: Both arms predict the same new training cases before seeing GT. Uniform samples from accumulated cases. Prioritized samples with weight 1+3*(1-reachable_action_F1), without replacement; both train on 400 rows per round. Empty/empty action sets score 1. GT drugs absent from the fixed catalogue remain in evaluation recall but do not drive selection-module feedback.
selection: Keep the highest guard composite checkpoint for inference; continue training the latest checkpoint in both arms. Test is scored only after all round choices are frozen.
evaluation: Drug/core-order F1, output validity, round curves, adapter hashes, matched training and inference counts. This task selects supplied templates; novel dose generation is not claimed.
privacy: All patient data, feedback, adapters and generation stay local. No cloud training or uploads.
generation_envelope: Uniformly remove only a leading empty <think> whitespace </think> envelope before JSON parsing; report strict and normalized validity. Applied on development before any test evaluation.
intervention: Exact 20-position include/exclude mask; all other QLoRA training settings and patient memberships match v9.
development_motivation: Guard target count averages 3.635 reachable drugs, whereas v9 adapted outputs select 14.57--18.71. Design frozen before v9 test results exist.
caveat: Equal steps/examples/output caps; binary targets contain more explicit negative decisions and a different number of target tokens. This is an output/supervision intervention, not a token-identical objective.
